# Data Source: identitynow_tag

Use this data source to look up a tag by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_tag" "pci" {
  name = "PCI"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Tag ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Tag name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `tag_category_refs` (Attributes List) Objects the tag is assigned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_category_refs))

<a id="nestedatt--tag_category_refs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_category_refs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Object ID.
- `name` (String) Object name.
- `type` (String) Object type.
